jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.desc: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. Position SummaryÂ The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration Commissioning (SI C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â Key ResponsibilitiesÂ On-Site DeliveryÂ Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI C team.Â Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â Remote / Office DeliveryÂ Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â Project Configuration DeploymentÂ Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack Hold).Â Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â Scope IndependenceÂ This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â Preferred QualificationsÂ Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â What we Offer: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Health Care Concierge Service 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax Roth) Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability Long-Term Disability Voluntary Life AD D Insurance Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness Hospital Indemnity Insurance Pet Insurance Milk Stork Program Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick 10 Holidays) Training Development Why KPI Solutions? At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. jobs.title: Business Unit Leader, Expert-Assisted Services  (d/f/m)
jobs.desc: Our story Every year, millions struggle with tax filing or miss out on tax refunds. We’re fixing that. Our intuitive app empowers everyone, regardless of background, to file taxes confidently. Operating across Germany, Spain, and the UK, Taxfix Group (Taxfix and Steuerbot) is a team of over 400 professionals—tax experts, developers, and IT specialists—committed to solutions. Since 2016, we’ve enabled over 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for our customers. The opportunity Taxfix is creating expert-assisted digital tax services, blending software, AI, and licensed human expertise for easier filings. We're hiring a Business Unit Leader, Expert-Assisted Services to drive and scale this business area as a key growth engine. This senior role requires commercial and general management skills—defining customer segments, service design, pricing, demand generation, conversion, retention, and efficient scaling without compromising trust or quality. You’ll balance growth, margin, capacity, costs, and outcomes, working closely with peers across Product, Operations, Marketing/Growth, Data, and Finance, and aligning teams to business and commercial goals. Your responsibilities Business leadership: Set ambition, priorities, and execution plans, owning revenue, margin, conversion, retention, and outcomes. Customer strategy: Identify high-value segments and craft differentiated propositions and journeys. Pricing and packaging: Build offers addressing diverse needs, complexity, and willingness to pay, ensuring revenue quality and margin. Growth engine: Boost acquisition, booking, retention, and renewal through disciplined experimentation. Service model: Balance demand, expert capacity, quality, handling time, and cost; determine where automation or human expertise adds value. Product, commercial, and ops: Collaborate to translate insights into scalable roadmaps and workflows. AI integration: Apply AI to enhance customer guidance, personalization, delivery, QA, and workflows, maintaining quality and trust. Performance discipline: Create KPIs, forecasts, dashboards, and reviews to drive focus and accountability. Organization building: Define capabilities and ownership, prioritize hiring, and improve cross-functional execution. What success looks like Within 12 months: clearer customer/value proposition, structured pricing and offers, and a focused growth plan. Accelerated, more predictable revenue and recurring revenue growth. Improved conversion and retention via better product–customer fit. Stronger margins and unit economics through pricing, scope, and capacity alignment. Scalable operating model integrating automation, AI, and human expertise. Comprehensive commercial and operational KPIs (revenue, conversion, gross margin, time to submit, service quality, CSAT/NPS, chargebacks). Operating cadence enabling faster, data-driven decisions across teams. Your profile Extensive experience in GM, commercial leadership, growth, operations, or BU leadership within tech-enabled services. Direct responsibility for revenue and P L (pricing, margin, unit economics). Experience scaling hybrid digital/human service models. Deep understanding of service operations (capacity, utilization, quality, CX, cost-to-serve). Track record designing or refining pricing and propositions for varied customer needs. Strong commercial judgment across acquisition, conversion, retention, and recurring revenue. Builder mindset—moving from diagnosis to action. Proven cross-functional leadership beyond hierarchy. Data-driven, hypothesis-led in ambiguous settings. Professional German (C1+) and fluent English. Deep knowledge of the German or DACH consumer market. Relevant backgrounds We favor leaders who have built or scaled: Software- or tech-enabled consumer services Digital health, care, coaching, or advisory platforms FinTech, TaxTech, LegalTech with a significant human-service aspect Subscription businesses with operational complexity Marketplaces or managed services balancing demand, expert capacity, and quality Businesses integrating digital funnels with human support A consulting or top-tier academic background helps but cannot substitute for hands-on operational experience and measurable business impact. How you operate Think and act like an owner, making strategic choices. Comfortable with customer segmentation, pricing, margin, utilization, and quality. Use data for decisions, acting without waiting for perfect info. Turn strategy into experiments, operating rhythms, and measurable results. Create cross-functional clarity and rally teams around business goals. Prioritize customer trust and delivering the right service for sustainable growth. Working model and stakeholders Reports to: COO or designated leader Scope: Full business leadership for Expert-Assisted consumer offering Partners: Product, Operations/Service Delivery, Tax Experts, Marketing/Growth, Finance, Data/Analytics, Legal, People Model: Cross-functional, in close partnership with senior leaders Initial focus: Germany, with potential to expand Why Taxfix? We support our clients in developing differentiated, stable, usable, and safe injectable treatments for patients. Your mission We are looking for a Senior Automation OT Engineer to develop our automation strategy while ensuring the day-to-day reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement of the operational technology running our production equipment. Sitting at the intersection of automation engineering and IT operations, you will lead complex projects and act as the primary technical expert for the shop floor. You will balance hands-on troubleshooting of PLCs and servers with structured, GMP-compliant change management to support safe, efficient manufacturing. Key Responsibilities Strategy Leadership: Co - develop and support the site's overall automation strategy. Manage project pipelines, budgets, CAPEX/OPEX engineering tasks, and end-to-end hardware/software lifecycle planning. Systems Operations IT: Execute daily maintenance and troubleshooting for automation hardware (HMIs, PLCs). Administer if applicable underlying IT infrastructure, including Windows Servers, OS patching, OT network segmentation, and cybersecurity hygiene. Process Equipment Expertise: Oversee automation systems for critical fill and finish operations, including filling lines, isolators, freeze dryers, autoclaves and building utilities. GMP CSV Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to cGMP, Data Integrity, and CSV regulations. Draft and update technical documentation, execute rigorous change control, and support validation activities. Disaster Recovery: Maintain and regularly test backup/restore and disaster recovery procedures to ensure the uptime and validated state of all production equipment. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with manufacturing, QA, and maintenance teams to optimize systems. Manage vendor SLAs, maintain spare parts inventory, and provide on-call support for critical system alarms. Your profile We are looking for a motivated and committed professional who is ready to actively grow with us, combining in-depth technical knowledge with a pronounced cooperative spirit. The ideal candidate possesses: Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Engineering, or a related technical field. 5+ years of hands-on industrial automation or IT experience within a GMP Pharma environment, ideally with direct exposure to fill and finish operations. Strong technical proficiency in automation hardware (PLC SCADA Systems), HMI/SCADA configuration, Windows Server administration, and OT cybersecurity fundamentals. Proven leadership experience with excellent communication skills, structured problem-solving under pressure, and a strong ownership mindset. Deep familiarity with GMP/CSV concepts (GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11) and modern data integration architecture. Fluent in English (working language); German is a strong advantage for on-site shop floor communication. Why us? We offer a dynamic environment where you can contribute meaningfully, collaborate with exceptional minds, and unlock your full potential. Here's what sets ten23 apart: A valuable and impactful career development opportunity in an inspiring environment Flexible working arrangements and environment with an open culture and diverse workforce The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees Our learning and self-developing culture offers a wide range of training options Competitive pension fund plan, annual bonus, and other financial and non-financial benefit At ten23 we believe in self-responsibility and mutual trust. Therefore, we will provide our employees as much flexibility as possible and limit any bureaucracy to a minimum, whilst ensuring compliance with all applicable laws.
